subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Find out who each WOW! Team member is from their profile.
Answer questions about the About Us page.
Decide if a sentence is true, false or doesn't say.

tf.s: Frank is thirteen and likes travelling with his parents.
tf.why: Yes, that is in Frank's profile.

tf.s: Majid usually wears an Omani hat and a dishdasha.
Bayan was hungry when she went camping because they didn't take enough food.
tf.why: Yes, they didn't take enough food.

tf.s: Emily usually wears her long coat in Oman.
tf.why: It is not usually cold enough in Oman to wear it.

tf.s: Egyptian food tastes like Spanish food.
Majid has been camping in dangerous places.
tf.why: He hasn't been camping anywhere dangerous.

tf.s: All the students in Majid's class know some first aid.
tf.why: Yes, they all know some first aid.
She has been camping twice before.

tf.s: “Doesn't say” means the text says the opposite.
tf.why: Doesn't say means the text gives no information; false means it says the opposite.

tf.s: A compass and a camping stove are words for the outdoors.
tf.why: Yes, we use them when we go camping.

boxes.why: Majid wears an Omani hat and dishdasha.
She has been camping twice before.

boxes.q: Which food tastes like Spanish food?
boxes.why: The text says Egyptian food tastes like Spanish food.

boxes.q: Why was Bayan hungry when she went camping?
It isn't cold ___ to wear a long coat.
boxes.why: Enough comes after the adjective: cold enough.

boxes.q: Which word is clothes or an accessory?
What do you write when the text gives no information?

boxes.why: After love, we often use the -ing form.

boxes.q: Which word is a first aid item?
boxes.why: We use a bandage for first aid.

hunt.q: You use it to find the way

mcq.q: Who usually wears an Omani hat and dishdasha?
Who is thirteen and likes travelling with his parents?
Complete: All the students in Majid's class know some ___.
mcq.why: They all know some first aid.

mcq.q: What does DS mean in a reading task?
T, F or DS? Frank likes cooking and wants to cook more.
mcq.why: The text says this, so it is true.

mcq.q: T, F or DS? Majid has been camping in dangerous places.
mcq.why: The text says he hasn't been anywhere dangerous.

o: She has been camping twice before.
She is thirteen and travels with her parents.

mcq.q: Why doesn't Emily usually wear her long coat?
o: It is not usually cold enough in Oman.
It is too big for her.
mcq.why: Oman is not usually cold enough for a long coat.

mcq.q: What is the difference between F and DS?
o: F: the text says the opposite. DS: the text gives no information.
F: the text gives no information. DS: the text says the opposite.
F is for people; DS is for places.
mcq.why: Look for proof: opposite = F, nothing = DS.

mcq.q: Bayan was hungry on her last camping trip. What will she probably do next time?
mcq.why: They were hungry because they didn't take enough food.
